name: Lei nº 15.211, de 17 de setembro de 2025 (Estatuto Digital da Criança e do Adolescente — ECA Digital)
description: Brazilian federal statute protecting children and adolescents in digital environments, establishing safety-by-design duties, privacy-preserving age assurance, parental supervision tools, and protection against emotional manipulation and harmful interactions across online platforms and conversational AI interfaces accessible to minors.
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by Presidência da República do Brasil (planalto.gov.br) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
relationToAISecurity: Governs data protection, automated decision-making, cybersecurity, or AI system compliance within Presidência da República do Brasil (planalto.gov.br).
